title: MGRS coverage and cloud statistics
description:
One row per MGRS tile per month, aggregated from the `sentinel-2-l2a` item index. Each row holds the scene count, the minimum and median cloud cover, and the least-cloudy scene of the month with its id and UTC date. It also holds the mean and maximum percent of the tile its scenes fill, taken from `s2:nodata_pixel_percentage` and NULL where no scene carried that property. Every percent is stored rounded to an integer 0-100.

Three parquet products are cut from the same table. `mgrs-monthly.parquet` is the full table, sorted by tile in small row groups, so one tile's history is a range read. Each `months/YYYY-MM.parquet` is that table cut to one month, with the paint columns only. `timeline.parquet` carries one row per month over all tiles.

The collection answers "which month has a cloud-free scene here" without a scan of the full item archive, and it backs the timeline and the choropleth in the explorer app. A companion PMTiles carries one polygon per MGRS tile, the envelope of that tile's scene footprints. The app joins tile-month statistics onto that fixed geometry by `mgrs_tile`, so a daily stat refresh never rewrites the tileset.

Scenes whose bbox spans more than 20 degrees of longitude are antimeridian wraps. The footprint polygons exclude them, although the monthly statistics still count them.

The table covers every month of the mirrored archive. The current year is recomputed daily, and the temporal extent, `updated` and the row count are measured from the table at each publish. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.

providers.name: European Space Agency (ESA)
providers.description: Operates the Sentinel-2 mission and produces the L2A surface reflectance products these statistics are aggregated from.

providers.name: Element 84 (Earth Search)
providers.description: Runs the Earth Search STAC API whose sentinel-2-l2a item index this collection's statistics are aggregated from.

providers.name: Taylor Geospatial
providers.description: Aggregates the mirrored item index into MGRS tile-month statistics and a tile-footprint PMTiles.

table:columns.name: mgrs_tile
table:columns.description: MGRS tile id, such as 53HNV. Join key against the mgrs.pmtiles feature id.

table:columns.name: scene_count
table:columns.description: Number of sentinel-2-l2a scenes for this tile and month.

table:columns.name: min_cloud_cover
table:columns.description: Lowest eo:cloud_cover among this tile's scenes for the month, rounded to an integer percent 0-100.

table:columns.name: median_cloud_cover
table:columns.description: Median eo:cloud_cover among this tile's scenes for the month, rounded to an integer percent 0-100.

table:columns.name: mean_cover
table:columns.description: Mean over the tile-month's scenes of 100 - s2:nodata_pixel_percentage, rounded to an integer percent: the average percent of the MGRS tile a scene fills. Skips NULL nodata values; NULL when none of the scenes carry one.

table:columns.name: max_cover
table:columns.description: Maximum over the tile-month's scenes of 100 - s2:nodata_pixel_percentage, rounded to an integer percent: the largest percent of the MGRS tile any one scene fills (100 = at least one full-tile scene). NULL under the same conditions as mean_cover.

table:columns.name: best_item_id
table:columns.description: Item id of the least-cloudy scene for this tile and month.

table:columns.name: best_item_date
table:columns.description: UTC calendar date of best_item_id's acquisition. Look the item up in sentinel-2-l2a by id for the full datetime.

data.title: MGRS tile x month statistics
data.description: The full table, every tile and month, sorted by (mgrs_tile, year, month) in 50k-row groups so a filter on one mgrs_tile is a range read of one row group plus a small footer. One months/YYYY-MM.parquet slice per month sits beside it (see README).

timeline.title: Month timeline over all tiles
timeline.description: One row per (year, month) across every tile: tile_count, summed scene_count and the minimum min_cloud_cover, sorted by year and month; its last row names the newest month that has a months/YYYY-MM.parquet slice.
